rent_counted.note: Short-term: 50% of a market rent from Form 1007 or three comparable short-term rentals, offset against the house's own cost only.

reserves.plus: six months of the new loan's principal and interest (the reader's own figure)
reserves.financed_properties: 2 or 3 (the first rental, the new one, and the reader's home if it has a mortgage): the 2 percent tier

worst_case.plus: three payments on each loan (the reader's own figure)
